description: Node-as-function invocation for lambda-valued nodes (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §3.8). OxFml parses the call and OxCalc resolves the callee as a single TreeCalc reference; LAMBDA arity/closure/value semantics remain OxFml/OxFunc owned.

cases.name: bare lambda-valued node is callable
cases.activation_dependency: OxFml W074 must freeze the built-in/UDF/defined-name/defined-name-LAMBDA call precedence lane; until then this maps to the closest Excel defined-name LAMBDA lane and remains pending.

expect.engine_ref: single host reference used as call callee

cases.note: The callee reference resolves by ordinary walk-up; invocation semantics and result value are Excel/LAMBDA-aligned upstream.

cases.name: relative path callee is callable
cases.activation_dependency: OxFml W074 must confirm the host-reference-as-call-callee lane for lambda-valued nodes before activation.

expect.engine_ref: RelativePath{ base: ParentNode, path: [Rate] } used as call callee

cases.name: set-valued reference cannot be a call callee

expect.reason: only single-reference resolutions are callable; a set-producing reference cannot be invoked
